01

PRIMARY LOCKUP

Observed

The circuit-trace L monogram with the name set in Geist Medium. Glyph and wordmark are optically centred on the same baseline.

Master / violet on pitch 256 PX SRC · PNG · RGB
LUCAS FRASCA

Constraint worth knowing. The master is a 256 px raster (src/assets/logo.png). There is no vector original in the repo, which caps faithful reproduction at roughly 21 mm at 300 dpi. Anything larger — signage, print, apparel — needs the mark redrawn as an SVG first.

03

CLEAR SPACE & SCALE

Proposed

X = height of the glyph. Minimums below are derived from the sizes the site actually ships.

X LUCAS FRASCA

Exclusion zone of 0.5 X on all sides. Nothing enters it — not type, not a rule, not a section edge.

Reproduction minimums

Clear space, all sides0.5 X

Print ceiling @ 300 dpi21 mm
Glyph → wordmark gap0.25 X
Corner radius, glyph20%
04

MISUSE

Proposed

Four failures. Each one breaks either legibility or the link back to the favicon.

LUCAS FRASCA

Never stretch, condense or skew the lockup.

LUCAS FRASCA

Never recolour outside the approved palette.

LUCAS FRASCA

Never place violet on violet or any low-contrast ground.

LUCAS FRASCA

Never add glows, shadows or strokes — the mark carries its own.

18.58:1

✓ WCAG AAA

Bone on pitch. The default for all body and UI text.

14.32:1

✓ WCAG AAA

Amber on pitch. The strongest accent — safe at any size.

5.22:1

✓ WCAG AA

Violet on pitch. Clears AA — but not AAA, so avoid for long runs of copy.

4.62:1

✓ WCAG AA — thin

Indigo on pitch clears the 4.5 floor by 0.12. Treat as a graphic colour, not a text colour.

One value fails. --destructive #DC2828 measures 4.30:1 on pitch and misses AA for body-size text. It is currently unused in any rendered component; lighten it before it ships in an error state.

07

THE SPECTRUM

Observed

Indigo → violet → amber. The brand's only decorative device, and it appears in six components.

#6366F1 · STOP 1 · 0%
#A855F7 · STOP 2 · 50%
#FCD34D · STOP 3 · 100%

Scroll progress · to right

3 px rail pinned to the viewport top, scaled by document progress.

Timeline spine · to bottom

Inverted — amber leads. Fills as the experience section enters view.

Active nav · to right

AboutExperienceSkills

1 px underline, scaled on the X axis from the left origin.

Inconsistency found. The gradient is declared five separate times across the codebase and runs in three different directions — to right, to left and to bottom. It should be a single token with one canonical direction and one documented inversion.

09

INVENTORY & OPEN QUESTIONS

Asset inventory

  • logo.png — 256 px master
  • favicon-256 / 180 / 32 .png
  • favicon.ico
  • og.png — 1200 × 630
  • All generated by recolor-favicon.py and make-og-image.swift

Open questions

  • No vector master. Blocks print and apparel above 21 mm.
  • No wordmark rule. The name has never been locked to the glyph — the nav ships the glyph alone.
  • Mono face unspecified. font-mono falls through to the OS stack.
  • Gradient direction varies across five declarations.
  • #DC2828 fails AA at 4.30:1.

Governance

src/index.css and tailwind.config.ts are the source of truth for every colour and face on this sheet. Anything marked PROPOSED has not been written back to the repo and carries no authority until approved. Supersedes no prior artefact — this is the first identity sheet for the property.
